tei:div.tei:p: (ka)༄༅// chos rje sa skya paṇḍi ta chen po'i rnam thar gsung sgros ma bzhugs// ༈ /bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// gang gi rang bzhin kun nas rnam dag brjod pa'i yul las rab 'das kyang*// smon lam mthar phyin gzhan gyis dbang gis rnam pa sna tshogs kun sprul zhing*// srid zhi'i dbang phyug mgon po de nyid gsum po rang bzhin 'gyur med sku// bla ma mchog la gus pas btud nas rnam thar cha tsam bdag gis brjod// bdag cag gi bla ma chos kyi rje 'di ni nges par rdo rje 'chang yin mod/ de lta na'ang so so skye bor mthong zhing btags so// 'on kyang ngo mtshar ba'i rnam pa thar pa 'ga' zhig mthong ste/ 'di ltar chos kyi rje pa 'di dang po yum gyi lhums su zhugs pa'i dus su/ byang chub sems dpa' yum gyi lhums su zhugs pa'i rmi ltas yum la byung ste/ klu'i rgyal po rin po che'i mgo rgyan la sogs pas mig gis kyang bltar mi bzod pa lta bus brgyan pa cig khyod la gnas khang g.yar ba yin zer nas byon pa rmis/ lhums na bzhugs pa'i dus na yang*/ yum la lus ldang ba yang ba dang*/ zo mdog bde ba dang*/ rgyud la ting nge 'dzin bzang po byung*/ bltams pa'i tshe yang*/ byang chub sems dpa' bltams pa'i ltas tsho byung*/ de nas skyed cung zad bsrings te/ gog thal thub pa'i dus su/ skye ba snga ma'i bag chags sad pa'i stobs kyis saṃ skṛ ta'i skad du smra ba byung bas/ yum na re/ 'di la rang gu ba cig 'ong ba lags sam/ gtam go rgyu med pa'i ngag ngog mang po zer ba gcig gda' zhus pas/ rje pas saṃ skṛ ta'i skad mkhyen pas/ khyod kyi bu la gu ba byung dogs med gsungs/ yang sa la phyag mdzub gyis na ga ra dang*/ lāñtsa la sogs pa'i rgya gar gyi ā li kā li tshang bar bris nas/ de la klog pa'i tshul mdzad nas/ yang mi 'gom par phyag gis zul gyis phyis kyin btang ba byung*/ yang rgya klog dang*/

bod klog gnyis ka ma bslabs par snga mor shes 'dug ste/ sngon la 'di shes dran pa tsam mi 'dug gsungs/ de nas cung zad cher skyes pa dang*/ yi ge'i bye brag rgya yig bod yig la sogs pa dang*/ rtsis dang*/ gso dpyad dang*/ ri mo la sogs pa bzo'i bye brag thams cad kyang bslabs tsam nyid nas tshegs med du mkhyen cing*/ gzhon nu nas yon tan gyi gter chen por gyur pas/ mkhas pa gzhan du ma dang*/ nyid kyi slob dpon du gyur pa de dag kyang sprul pa dang byin gyis brlabs pa yin gyi/ rang rgyud pa ma yin no// zhes gsungs shing*/ kun gyis ngo mtshar du 'dzin to// gzhan yang gzhon nu nyid nas rang gi yab dge ba'i bshes gnyen gsang sngags rig pa nyid la dbang bskur ba nod de/ dges pa rdo rje sgrub thabs mtsho skyes dang*/ yan lag drug pa dang*/ dbang chu dang*/ rab gnas/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga 'khor lo bde mchog lo hi pa/ rdo rje dril bu skor gsum/ mchod pa'i lag len dang*/ mi g.yo ba/ sgrol ma/ 'jam dpal spyan ras gzigs/ rnam rgyal/ 'od zer can/ rdo rje rnam 'joms la sogs pa'i sgrub thabs thugs dam du mdzad pa rnams dang*/ rtsa ltung*/ bla ma lnga bcu pa/ sdom pa nyi shu pa/ phyag na rdo rje mdo lugs brtag pa'i skor bcas pa/ sman dpyad kyi gzhung man ngag rnams gsan cing thugs su chud par mdzad do// yang rje btsun rin po che la dbang byin rlabs kyi rgyud 'grel man ngag la sogs pa yab mes kyi chos rnams rim gyis gsan cing sbyangs par mdzad nas/ dgung lo brgyad pa'i dus su/ mtsho skyes la bshad pa mdzad/ bcu gnyis pa la brtag gnyis la bshad pa mdzad/ bcu bzhi pa la sambu ṭa gsung*/ bco lnga lon pa dang yab mes kyi chos lugs ma lus pa thugs su chud par mdzad do// de nas dgung lo bco brgyad pa'i dus su/ mnal lam du/ sa skya'i ltag gi a phyi'i mchod rten de'i drung du slob dpon dbyig gnyen las mdzod gsan te/

de yang nub gcig la zla ba gcig gi snang ba byung*/ slob dpon mchod rten drung nas zhal shar du gzigs nas gsung*/ slob dpon de yang sku mdog bag gis sngo ba cha lugs sku nyams la sogs pa sgeg drag kyang ma yin pa/ dar yol ba ltar du snang*/ dus snga dro'i tshe na/ chos thun sum cu la rdzogs par gsungs/ chos rje slob dpon gyi g.yas nas zhal byang du gzigs te/ dpe bkram nas gsan par rmis te/ mnal sad pa dang*/ tshig don kun thugs la byung 'dug gsungs/ phyis bla ma paṇa chen las dngos su gsan pa dang mthun par byung gsungs so// yang nub gcig gi mnal lam na/ mi gcig na re/ phyogs kyi glang po'i gdan sa gtod pas 'byon par zhu zer nas/ rgya gar shar phyogs su phyogs glang gi phug pa yin zer ba'i sgo shar du bltas pa zhig tu byon/ sgo phyes te nang du byon pa dang*/ phyogs gcig na ka pod mang po 'dug pa gzigs nas/ de dag zhal dbye bar byas pa'i tshe/ mi cig gis na bza'i sna nas phyir 'then pa snyam byed pa cig byung bas/ mnal sad nas dpe gzigs long ma byung*/ de ni da lta'i g.yeng ba mang po dang*/ mtha' mi la sogs pas nyan bshad kyi bar chad cung zad byed pa 'di la lta ba 'dra gsungs so// de'i rjes la tshad ma la rtogs pa khyad par can skyes gsungs/ de nas dgung lo bcu dgu lon pa'i dus su/ 'phrang du dge bshes zhu hrul la byams chos dang tshad ma'ang bag tsam gsan/ dgung lo nyi shu pa'i dus su nyang stod rkyang 'dur du dge bshes mtshur gzhon nu seng ge'i drung du tshad ma gsan du byon pas/ nyams khrid tshar gcig la tshig don ma lus pa thugs la byon nas bshad par zhus pas/ khong rang gi blo yi rgyas bkab ste/ mgo ma thon gyis dogs nas/ da rung nyon gsungs/ rnam nges stod tshar bzhi smad tshar gnyis gsan/ de'i dus na mtshur na re/ ldog pa shwa mang gi sul bzhin du yod zer bas/ rgya gar gyi bshad lugs rang 'di 'dra cig min snyam pa de dus rang nas byung gsungs/

de nas chos rje pa rang gi yab slob dpon cung zad bsnyung zer nas yar byon pas/ khong sku gshegs/ der rjes kyi bya ba mdzad dgongs pas/ mtshur la/ bdag da lo bshad gsar byed pa lags pas/ chos zhag bar 'then mdzad par zhu/ zhes phrin bskur bas slob dpon zhag 'ga' mi bshad par bzhed pas/ grwa pa tshos ma nyan te/ chos rje pa la/ slob dpon thugs la 'dogs pas/ de grwa pa tshos mi theg khyad par du ya ma stag thengs 'jug khyod la jo sras sa skya pa kas chog na/ nged tsho 'gyes so// nged kyang dgos na chos shod zer/ der bshad/ de nas chos rje pas rnam gzhag gi yo byad mang po bsnams nas mar byon pas/ dbyar chos gang 'khor du byung ste/ der rnam gzhag rgya chen po mdzad/ bka' rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum phul nas/ slob dpon na re/ chos dbu nas bskyar nas bshad kyi gsungs pas/ mi 'tshal bya ste/ slob dpon gyi gsung la yang ma brten par/ rnam nges dbu nas gcig btsugs/ gzhung don nas gcig btsugs te/ nyin re chos thun gnyis gnyis bshad de/ zla ba gcig la gzhung rnam par nges par tshar gcig thugs la yang gsungs pas/ grwa sa na yod pa thams cad ngo mtshar du 'dzin pa byung*/ de nas slob dpon de nyid las phyis dbu ma rigs tshogs kyang gsan/ de nas sa skyar byon nas yab kyi gshegs brdzangs la sogs pa rjes kyi bya ba rnams tshar nas/ rkyang 'dur du gser mang ba cig gis sna drangs pa'i 'bul ba cig skyel du byon pa'i lam du/ chu mig ring mor bla ma kha che ba dang mjal te/ tshad ma chos mchog cig gsung gin 'dug pa'i 'phro la slebs nas/ der 'bul ba rnams g.yog po tsho bskyel du btang ste/ chos rje pa chos gsan gyin bzhugs/ der bla ma kha che ba rgya dpe la gsungs pa la/ chos rje pas bod dpe cig bkram pas/ paṇa chung tsho dgod cing khong la khrel 'dug pas/ bla ma na re/ khyed tsho ci la dgod gsungs/ der chos rje pas bod dpe bkram pa la dgod par 'dug ste/

bla ma'i zhal nas/ chos rje pa la/ khyod dpe des ci la phan pa/ ci la'ang mi phan gsungs pas/ der chos rje pa na re/ gzhan la mi phan kyang bdag rang la phan par gda'i byas te/ bod dpe la rgya skad du bsgyur te/ bklags pas ji lta ba bzhin du mkhyen pas/ paṇa chung tsho dngos la bka' bkyon byung ste/ khyed tsho ci la dgod pa/ sa skya pa kho rang gi shes shing 'dug pa gsungs/ der bla ma la bdag cag bod la/ sngo ma yin las logs pa'i sngo tsam bya ba cig 'dod lags na/ de ci ltar lags zhus pas/ sngon po don la yod/ tsam tsam mam de nga la cha med gsungs pas/ tshad ma'i gnad thams cad der go gsungs/ der bla ma'i paṇa chung*/ dā na shī la la'ang tshad ma'i chos skor mang po dang*/ ku ru kulle dang*/ rnal 'byor pa'i dbyangs gshin rje'i gshed dmar po dang*/ mi g.yo ba dkar po la sogs pa gsan/ bal po saṃ gha shrī las sgra'i bstan bcos dang*/ tshad ma rnam 'grel la sogs pa gsan/ des na chos rje'i zhal nas/ nga bsod nams rang che bar byung*/ rgya gar shar nub gnyis na/ bal po saṃ gha shrī bas sgra mkhas pa med par 'dug ste/ de nga'i gam du gtsang byung ba yin gsungs/ de nas bla ma kha che ba dbus su gshegs te/ chos rje pas paṇḍi ta su ga ta shrī sa skyar gdan drangs nas/ lo gnyis su sgra dang*/ tshad ma dang*/ snyan dngags dang*/ sdeb sbyor la sogs gsan nas thams cad thugs su chud par mdzad/ de nas dus phyis bla ma kha che ba gtsang du byon nas/ nyung chung na bzhugs pa'i dus na/ chos rje pas mjal du byon nas/ der rab tu byung bar bzhed de/ rje pa la zhu yig bskur ba gnang nas/ dgung lo nyi shu rtsa lnga pa la/ nyang smad rgyan gang gi gtsug lag khang du zer yang lo ston gyi bzhugs sa yin pas dbu skra der bzhar ba ma gtogs pa sdom pa nyung chung du blangs gsung*/ bla ma kha che bas mkhan po mdzad/ byang chub sems dpa' spyi bo lhas pas las slob/ dge bshes zhu hrul gyis gsang ston mdzad nas/

dge 'dun rgya mtsho lta bu'i dbus su bsnyen par rdzogs pa mdzad nas/ kha che ba'i zhal nas da rab tu byung nas de'i bya cha dang bsrung sdom la brtson par gyis gsungs nas/ chos rje pa'i drung du/ jo gdan shin tu thu mo cig bzhag nas/ 'phral gyi spyod lam thams cad la skyon btang gin pa cig byung*/ de nas bla ma kha che pa la tshad ma sde bdun lan gsum dang*/ rgyan dang*/ chos mchog la sogs pa 'grel pa chen po yan lag dang bcas pa gsan/ yang de nyid la/ mngon pa mdzod/ 'dul ba mdo rtsa/ so so thar pa/ dge slong gi kā ri kā la sogs pa 'dul ba'i phrin thams cad dang*/ gzhan yang dus 'khor gyi 'grel pa dri ma med pa'i 'od la sogs pa de'i cha lag thams cad dang*/ gzhan yang bde mchog gsang 'dus 'phags skor/ ye shes zhabs lugs la sogs pa'i cha lag thams cad gsan cing*/ de dag gi dbang bskur ba zhus shing thams cad thugs su chud par mdzad do// de nas slob dpon spyi bo lhas pa la pha rol tu phyin pa brgyad stong 'grel pa/ nyi khri'i 'grel pa/ mngon pa kun las btus/ spyod phyogs tsho/ bka' gdams kyi chos tsho gsan/ gsang sngags kyi man ngag phra mo 'ga' zhig kyang gsan/ gzhan yang thugs dam mdzad pas/ ting nge 'dzin bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' bas/ phyi nang gi rten 'brel zab mo'i 'gros thugs su chud pas/ ma 'ongs pa'i don 'ga' zhig 'di ltar 'byung zhes lung ston pa'ang mdzad/ mi mang po'i gseb tu bzhugs kyang*/ thugs dam mam/ gzigs rtog gang mdzad kyang gzhan rkyen gyis g.yeng bar mi nus so gsung*/ yang bla ma'i byin rlabs zhugs pa la brten nas kyang*/ lung rtog gi yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa rgyud la 'khrungs pa yin te/ chos rje nyid kyi gsung las/ kho bo yang gzhon pa'i dus su/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi byin rlabs zhus pas khyod kyis sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes mi skye/ khu bo'i 'du shes skye/ lus longs spyod kyis bla ma'i phyogs su dka' thub mi nus gsungs nas ma gnang*/

phyis 'chi ltas 'jigs pa cig byung*/ khams kyang ma bde/ de'i skabs su/ chos rje rin po che la sku khams ma bde ba zhag 'ga' byung*/ der nyin mtshan rgyun mi chad par/ gnyid dang kha zas kyi 'du shes ma byas par zhabs tog byas/ des sdig pa cung zad dag pa 'dra/ de nas bla ma'i rnal 'byor 'di gnang bas/ bla ma la sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes skyes/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo 'phags pa 'jam dpal du mthong*/ mos gus thun mong ma yin pa skyes/ de nyid kyis 'chi ltas las grol/ khams shin tu bde/ de nas sgra tshad ma/ snyan dngags/ sdeb sbyor/ tshig gi rgyan/ gsang sngags pha rol tu phyin pa/ mngon pa/ 'dul ba la sogs pa'i lung dang rigs pa'i gnad rnams phyin ci ma log par gzod go /sde snod thams cad la mi 'jigs pa'i spobs pa thob/ lha 'dre mi gsum yang thams cad byams par byung*/ rgya gar gyi rgyal po la sogs pa nga rgyal can thams cad kyang nged la chos zhu zer nas rtsis byed pa gzod byung*/ nang du yang dag pa'i rtog pa cung zad kyang skyes/ de'i tshe kho bo la phan par bya ba'i don du rten 'brel 'grig par bya ba'i phyir bsnyung ba'i tshul bstan pa yin gyi/ dngos ma yin par snang*/ gzhan gyis kyang de ltar byas na rten 'brel phyin ci ma log par 'grig par 'gyur bar the tshom mi za'o// zhes 'byung ba dang*/ gzhan yang dngos su 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ mi g.yo mgon po dang*/ sgrol ma la sogs pa rnams gzigs shing*/ dbugs phyung nas chos kyi sgo du ma yang bstan la/ de la brten nas/ ting nge 'dzin dang*/ yon tan gyi chos du ma yang rgyud la skyes par gyur to// yang nub cig gis mnal lam du/ rdo'i khra tshan pa cig gi steng du bzhugs nas tshogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa la chos gsungs te/ rtog pa'i drwa ba rnam bsal zhing*// zab cing rgya che'i sku mnga' ba// kun tu bzang po'i 'od zer dag /kun nas 'phro la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes rnam 'grel gyi mchod brjod de/

saṃ skṛ ta'i skad kyi gsungs pa'i tshe/ bla ma'i sku'i phrag pa g.yas g.yon nas/ nyi zla gnyis dus gcig la shar ba'i snang ba byung*/ nangs par rje btsun pa'i spyan sngar zhus pas/ rje btsun pa'i zhal nas/ de ni 'byung bar dka' ba'i rmi lam yin pas mchod pa dang dga' ston rgya chen po bya bar rigs/ de ltar byos shig gsungs nas/ mang skol cig byas gsungs/ yang nub kyi grog po de na mar chu chen po cig 'bab cing 'dug de'i gad pa'i steng na chos rje rin po che bzhugs nas/ slob dpon bsod nams kyis bteg nas/ sngags kyi chos mang po dbyangs kyis gsungs/ chos rje gad pa la 'dzeg cing gsan/ kha cher bla ma paṇa chen la yang de lta bu'i mtshan ma byung*/ phyis gleng bslangs pas nub gcig par 'dug de nas rmi lam ma yin par dngos su byon pa ni/ sa skya na chos gsungs pa'i tshe bar snang du byung ba la sgra snying ga'i gting shed na grags pa snyam byed pa'i sgra lhangs kyis byung ste/ khyod kyis tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi paṇḍi ta bar ma chad par skye ba nyi shu rtsa bdun du byas pa yin zer/ phyis lan cig gi tshe sum cu so bdun zer ba byung gsungs/ gzhan gyi skabs su sgra tshad slob pa la rtsol ba tsam ma dgos te/ sngar gyi bag chags yod pa 'dra/ zhes yang yang gsungs/ yang chos gsungs pa'i tshe/ bar snang ngam thugs ka nas khyod ni rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi sprul pa yin/ sangs rgyas gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyis kyang gdul bar ma nus pa'i sems can mang po 'dul bar nus zer ba'i sgra cig byung*/ phyis g.yas ru skya bo kha gdangs kyi gtsug lag khang na chos gsungs pa'i tshe na/ de ni khyod kyi skye ba mang po'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen yin no zer ba'i sgra cig byung ba'i tshe/ sngar gyi sgra de tur gyis dran pa byung gsungs so// yang dus gcig cung zad bsnyung ba na/ 'jam dbyangs dang*/ klu sgrub dang*/

zhi ba lha la sogs pa rnams kyis bsnyung gsol mdzad pa'i snang ba byung ba dang*/ bo dong rin po che la sogs pa dag pa'i gdul bya 'ga' zhig gis 'jam dbyangs dang dbyer med par mthong zhing nges pa rnyed par gyur to// mngon shes kyang mnga' ste byang ngos su byon pa'i dus su/ shing mo sbrul lo ston zla 'bring po shar ba dang phyag phebs nas 'grongs pa'i lo gcig gi gong lcags pho khyi'i lo ston zla tha chung shar ba na/ drung na 'dug pa 'ga' zhig la/ lcags phag la zhing gzhan du/ gshegs gsungs pa thog tu phebs so// mdzad pa'i phrin las la yang 'chad pa'i tshe rnam bshad rigs pa las 'byung ba ltar/ dgos bsdus tshig don mtshams sbyor brgal lan gyi sgo nas gzhung mtha' dag legs par gtan la phab cing*/ dris pa'i spobs pa thogs pa med par skabs su bab pa'i lan chos dang mthun par 'debs la/ rig pa'i gnas lnga gang 'chad kyang mkhas pa rnams kyi yid 'phrog par mdzad pa dang*/ mi ma yin dag gi the tshom gyi drwa ba'ang gcod par mdzad pa yin no// de yang chos rje pa bsam yas su byon pa dang btsad pos chos 'khor la spyan drangs nas/ lam 'bras a dor thon/ rgyud kyi'ang brtag pa phyi ma'i lnga pa thon tsam na/ srin po ri pa dang yon mchod kyi 'brel zab par yod pas/ btsun ston gyi gral mgo la gdan 'dren du byung*/ spyir yang dbus na dge bshes che ba re spyan 'dren 'bul ba tsho yang de la byed/ des thab kha re byed dgos zer/ der gzhung lhag mtsho bklag de nas chos dang gros dang*/ byin rlabs zhu ba mtshan gang byung*/ der go cha che shos cig na re/ 'o cag gi zhu don la tshar ba min yang da ltar bzhud pa yin/ sku khams ldog 'ong zer song*/ der nye gnas kyis phyi nas sgo lcags bcug ste/ tsog ge pa cig la mnal cig log pas mnal lam du mi skya shar tshan cig byung nas phyag 'tshal phyag rten phul nas/ gral mgo ma na re/ chos rje pa/

skye rga na 'chi'i chu bo bzhi po 'dis sems can thams cad sdug bsngal bar mi gda' ye zer/ de de bzhin du 'dug gsungs pas/ 'o na 'di la phan pa'i gsol 'debs 'dra bdog gam zer bas/ 'o na 'di bzhin du gsol ba thob gsungs te/ skye ba skye ba med pa'i tshul rtogs kyang*// da dung skye ba'i gzeb las bdag ma grol// skye ba kun tu skye bar skye 'gyur ba'i// skye ngan bdag gi skye ba'i skyabs mdzod cig /gyis la gsol ba thob gsungs pas/ 'o na rga ba la sogs pa'ang de bzhin du sbyar bas mchi bar mi gda' ye zer/ 'o na go 'dug snyam ste/ phyag re 'tshal nas/ thugs la btags zer song ba rmis te/ mnal sad de bsam pas de bzhin du 'ong bar 'dug gsung skad do// bstan bcos brtsams pa'i tshul la phan pa dang*/ sdeb sbyor gtso bor mdzad pa gnyis las/ phan pa gtsor mdzad pa yang tshig dang don la skyon med cing 'brel chags pa'i ngag gis mdo rgyud dang mthun par brjod bya gsal bar ston cing*/ de la yang mkhas pa rnams kyis skyon gdags par yang mi nus la/ ngo mtshar du 'dzin pa kho na yin no// sdeb sbyor gtsor mdzad pa yang*/ bde bar gshegs pa'i bstod pa dang*/ thugs rje la bskul ba dang*/ legs par bshad pa la sogs pa tshig don sdeb legs shing*/ dpe dang don mi 'gal ba/ lci yang dang ring thung la sogs pa legs par phyed cing*/ tshig gi rgyan dang*/ ngal bso ba'i gnas la sogs pas mdzes par byas la/ rtsom pa'i phreng ba mchog tu gyur pa mdzad pa rnams ni brjod pa bde zhing rna bar snyan la yid du 'ong ba yin te/ gser gyi rgyan rin po che padma rā ga dang*/ ind+ra nī la la sogs pas spras pa mu tig gi phreng bas bskor zhing*/ blta na sdug pa bas kyang mchog tu mdzes pa'i rtsom pa'i phreng ba rnams ni mthong zhing thos pa na/ mkhas pa rnams kyis yid dga' ba skye zhing blo gsal rnams kyi kha rgyan du gyur la/

shes ldan rnams yid smon gyi gnas su byed pa sha stag mdzad pa yin no// 'di'i rtsod pa'i tshul ni/ mtshungs pa med pa'i blo gros dang ldan zhing 'jigs pa med pa'i spobs pa brnyes nas phyin ci ma log pa'i gzhung lugs mkhyen pas/ rnam par dag pa'i ngag gis smras te/ skyon med pa'i dam bca' brjod cing bzlog par mi nus pa'i thal ba 'phen pas phas rgol gyi spobs ba myur du 'joms pa yin te/ rang gi sde pa la bod kyi blo gsal mkhas pa chen por rlom zhing smra ba por grags pa du ma yang pham par mdzad cing rgya gar gyi paṇḍi ta 'ga' zhig kyang zil gyis mnan la/ gzhan gyi sde pa 'phrog byed dga' bo la sogs pa phyi rol pa'i mkhas pa chen po drug kyang spobs pa med par byas nas/ lta ba mchog la btsud pa yin no// de ltar dgung lo drug cu re gsum pa'i bar du bod du bzhugs nas rim gnyis zab mo'i thugs dam la rtag tu mnyam gzhag gi ngang nas chos 'chad pa dang*/ rtsod pa dang rtsom pas dus 'da' bar byed cing sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nam langs pa la nyi ma shar ba lta bur mdzad pa'i dbang gis 'dzam bu'i gling thams cad du mkhas pa'i grags pas khyab pa dang*/ bla ma rje btsun chen pos/ dus phyis byang phyogs kyi rgyal khams nas mi skad rigs mi gcig pa/ zhwa khra 'phur ba 'dra ba gon pa/ lh+wam phag gi sna 'dra ba gon pas khyod gdan 'dren du 'ong ba yin/ de'i dus su the tshom ma byed par song dang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la phan pa rgya chen po 'byung*/ zhes lung bstan pa dang*/ rgyal bu go dan gyis/ chos rje pa'i sku'i snyan pa'i grags pa gsan pa la brten nas/ dpon po dor ta zhes bya ba gser yig pa la btang nas/ bod kyi yul na sa skya pa zhes bya ba'i bande bzang po cig yod par 'dug pas/ de khyod kyi gdan drangs la nged kyi rtsar slebs su chug gsung ba'i don la/ dpon po dor ta kho rang*/ bla ma chos rje pa la mjal nas/

rgyal bu go dan gyi lung bsgrags pas/ rje btsun chen po'i gsung dran pa'i stobs kyis dgyes shing spro ba dang bcas pas zhal gyis bzhes nas shing pho 'brug gi lo dgung lo drug cu rtsa gsum bzhes pa la/ sa skya nas khu dbon gsum gdan bteg nas byon pa la/ lam so na yod pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams dang*/ skal ba dang ldan pa'i gdul bya mang pos dbang byin rlabs dang*/ rgyud 'grel man ngag dang bcas pa la sogs pa dad pa chen po'i sgo nas zhu ba rnams la chos kyi 'khor lo bskor zhing byon pa'i dbang gis lam du lo gsum 'gor ro// de'i tshe dge ba'i bshes gnyen bka' gdams pa nam mkha' 'bum gyis/ har 'di la khyed kyi byon pas phan pa'i rgyu mtshan bdog gam zer ba la/ hor 'dis nged la cis kyang mchod gnas la shog mi 'ong na dmag 'ong zer bas dmag byung na bod la gnod kyis dogs nas 'gro ba lags/ sems can la phan du re nas 'gro ba ma gtogs pa phan nges pa'i rgyu mtshan ma mchis/ lar sems can la phan na rang gi lus srog gtong ba la mi phod rgyu mi bdog pa tsam shes pa la gda' gsungs/ mdo srang du phebs pa'i tshe mig cig gis/ dar nag po gcig la gser gyi thig le mang du byas pa cig phyag rten la byung*/ de lha rje bi ji la gnang nas/ de khyod rang tshags gyis gsungs/ nam mkha' dwangs pa la skar ma bkra ba lta bu'i bstan pa gcig 'o cag la 'ong ba yin gsungs/ sa skya pas ring bsrel bkag zer ba yod pa la/ de yang*/ ring bsrel phal cher gdon las byung*// dkar po'i phyogs kyis byas pa'ang srid// 'byung bzhi dag gis bskyed pa'ang yod// 'phags pa gsum gyi ring bsrel ni// yon tan stobs kyis 'byung ba ste// 'byung khungs nas byung ring bsrel yin// de la grangs ni brtsi ru med// mi 'grib 'phel ba'i ring bsrel yin// zhes bya ba yin pas/ nga la rten byon na grangs brtsi ru med pa cig 'byon pa yin pas/

khyed rang tshags gyis la dar 'dis de'i na bza' gyis gsungs/ ngas ku re byas pa yin/ mi la ma zlo/ sdig pa sog pa'i rgyu yin gsungs/ de nas dgung lo drug cu rtsa lnga bzhes pa'i dus su/ me pho rta'i lo zla ba brgyad pa la/ byang ngos ling chur gdan phebs/ de'i dus su rgyal bu go dan/ gu yug gan rgyal sar bton pa la hor yul du bzhud nas/ tshur byon pa dang lug lo zla ba gcig pa la mjal/ rgyal bu yang shin tu mnyes nas/ chos dang 'jig rten gyi lugs kyi gsung gleng mang po yang mdzad par gda'/ de'i gong du rgyal bu'i drung du bod kyi bande yang 'ga' re 'dug pa la/ sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi yon tan gyi khyad par gang yang bskyed par ma nus nas/ smon lam 'debs pa la dbang bar khas len pa 'tshogs pa'i dus su/ erka 'un dang*/ hor gyi lha pa tsho gral mgor 'jog pa yod par 'dug de nas rgyal bu dang bla ma chos rje pa chos kyi gsung gleng mang po mdzad pa la/ mgo ba'i skabs su yu gur gyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen mkhas pa mang pos kyang mtshams sbyor byas nas/ chos kyi don thams cad legs par gor bcug pas/ rgyal bu yang shin tu mnyes par byung nas/ de ring phyin chad erke 'un dang lha pa tsho bande'i gral mgor ma sdod/ thams cad kyi gral mgor bla ma chos rje pa bzhugs la/ smon lam 'debs pa'i dus su sngon la bande'i smon lam thob gsungs pa'i lung byon nas/ hor gyi rgyal khams su rab tu byung ba'i dbu 'phang bstod/ de nas rgyal bu go dan la sha bkra'i nad cung zad byung ba'i rim gror/ chab gtor 'jam dpal ma mang du mdzad pas/ lug lo zla ba gsum pa'i tshes bcu gcig gi tho rangs mnal lam du/ mi 'theng po lus la rma dang shu bas gang ba cig byung ba la/ khyod su yin ces dris pas/ nga la dpon gcig yod pa na re/ sa skya pas 'bod cing 'dug pas/ khyod song la ci zer nyon/ nga ni lus po na bas 'gro mi nus par 'dug zer nas yong ba yin zer/

de nas chos rje pas go dan gyis gser yig pa btang nas/ nged thag ring po nas bos/ da 'di la phan pa cig dgos par 'dug pas/ nad 'di'i rgyu ci yin/ da thabs ci byas pas phan zhes dris pas/ mi de na re/ yul phyogs 'di rnams sus kyang ma bzung ba'i dus su/ nga'i dpon des bdag po byas pa yin/ de'i tshe go dan 'di shākya mu ni la bsod nams bsags pa'i rgyal bu cig tu skyes/ de nas tshe 'phos nas mi nyag gi rgyal po cig tu skyes/ rgyal po des nga'i khang pa'i steng du mkhar las byas/ mi nyag rgyal po des kyang bande rnams la/ ngas mkhar las byed pa'i sa gzhi slong zer/ bande rnams dbyangs 'dra byed pa dang*/ rol mo 'dra dkrol ba dang*/ gtor ma 'dra btang gin 'dug ste/ sa chog mi shes par 'dug pas sa gzhi ma byin/ der rgyal pos mkhar las byas pas/ nged dpon g.yog ris non pa bzhin song*/ de nas mi yi bsod nams ma thub pas/ byang ngos 'dir 'ongs nas yul legs par bzung*/ der yang rgyal bu de 'ongs nas nged kyi steng du me btang*/ sa brkos/ gzhan yang gnod pa mang du byas/ der yang sdod sa ma byung*/ de nas nga'i dpon po de khros nas yul phyogs kyi lha 'dre rnams bsdus nas/ rgyal po 'dis nga yul lan gnyis phyung bas/ da 'di la gnod pa cig byed pas khyed rnams kyis grogs gyis byas pas/ lha 'dre rnams na re/ rgyal po 'di shākya mu ni la bsod nams bsags pa yin pas/ 'di'i stobs mi thub kyis/ khyod skam sar ma sdod par chu mig dang 'dam rdzab yod sar yul zung zer nas der bsdad pa'i dus su/ rgyal po des rgyal po snga ma kun gyi bande rnams la rgyugs byin pa'i yi ge bltas pas/ sngar gyi rgyugs ches zer nas phris/ de'i tshe rgya po des gser gyi shākya mu ni 'di nges par gser yin nam/ shing ngam/ rdo yin nam blta zhes zer te/ zhabs la gzong gis brkos pa dang*/ de nas lha 'dre rnams na re/

da 'di'i bsod nams kyi cha nyams pas bar chad bya ba'i dus la bab zer nas lha 'dre rnams 'tshogs pa dang*/ 'di bsod nams can yin pas/ gzhan sus kyang brlag par mi nus pas nang gi blon po dang rgyal po la phra ma gzhug zer nas phra ma bcug pas/ der blon pos bsad/ der rgyal po des 'chi khar smon lam btab ste/ nga tshe phyi ma la rgyal po cig gi bur skyes nas khyed rnams la gnod pa skyel zhing khyed rnams bran bzhin du 'khor bar shog cig ces smon lam btab pas/ jim gyi rgyal po'i tsha bor skyes te go dan yin/ des byang ngos 'dir yongs nas nged kyi sdod sa chu dang 'dam rdzab kyi steng du rta rgyug der rta bsad/ rta khrag gang song sar/ ngad la la na/ la la shi nga'i lus la yod pa'i sbal lcong 'di rnams kyang 'chi la khad pa la/ nga'i lus kyi drod kyis ma 'chi ba yin zer nas lus la sbal pa dang*/ lcong mo phyed skam pa dang*/ 'chi la khad yod pa la/ de gong gi bande rnams kyis go dan la smon lam 'dra 'debs pa las/ nged klu la phan pa ci'ang ma byung*/ da khyod sa skya pas sman dang bza' rgyu byin pas nged klu la phan par byung*/ nga gar yang 'gro mi nus pa la da res cung zad phan pa yin/ da nga yi dpon de 'chi la khad yod de/ de 'chi na go dan yang 'chi/ nga yi dpon de gsos na/ go dan yang gsos pas/ rim gro yang chung chung gis mi phan mi sos pas/ khyod kyis nga yi dpon po dang*/ go dan gso ba'i 'bad pa chen po gyis/ nga yi dpon po gsos na go dan yang gsos/ de gsos na khyod kyang bzang por 'gro zer/ de nas chos rje pa'i thugs dgongs la/ da 'di la thabs ci byas na phan 'dri snyam pa la/ bar chad cung zad cig gi de yal song gsungs so// de nas rgyal bu'i don du/ 'phags pa seng ge sgra'i cho ga mdzad pas/ rgyal po nad las thar bas shin tu dad de/ theg pa chen po'i sems bskyed la sogs pa zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos du ma zhus/

mchod gnas rnams kyi phud du bkur/ de nas bzung ste skad rigs mi gcig pa'i gdul bya chos la mi dad pa rnams chos la dad par byas/ dad pa rnams theg chen la btsud/ mdor na gdul bya dpag tu med pa smin cing grol bar mdzad pas bstan pa'i dar rgyas phul du phyin par mdzad do// de nas bod du byon pa bas kyang byang ngos su bzhugs na sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la phan che bar gzigs nas gnas de nyid du thugs phab/ bod kyi grwa slob rnams la gnang sbyin dang 'bul ba mang po bskur/ chos kyi skyes su byang chub sems dpa'i lam la 'jug pa'i rim pa thub pa'i dgongs pa gsal ba zhes bya ba bskur nas/ tshogs chos 'di dbus gtsang khams gsum du ngas bshad pa yin pas/ nga'i slob ma thams cad kyis lung thob pa yin pas yi ge 'di la ltos la shod/ 'di bzhin du nyams su longs gsung ngo*// de lta bu'i bla ma rtsod pa'i dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa gnyis pa de dgung lo bdun cu'i bar du rgyal ba'i bstan pa dang*/ sems can dpag tu med pa smin cing grol bar mdzad nas/ mthar gzugs kyi sku'i bkod pa ji ltar bsdu ba'i tshul slob dpon bi ji'i gsung ltar brjod na/ lcags mo phag gi lo la gzhan don la bzhud pa'i dus su/ tha skar gyi zla ba la ltas chen po bco brgyad byung*/ tha skar gyi tshes brgyad kyi nyin par sa g.yos chen po byung*/ bdag bi ji lha rjes rgyu mtshan zhus pas/ rgyal ba'i sras su gyur pa chen po rnams gzhan don la 'gro ba'i ltas yin/ 'o cag kyang de'i rjes su 'jug pa 'dra gsung*/ nyi shu dgu'i nam phyed na longs sku'i cha lugs sgra dbyangs mi zad pa sgrogs pa'i rgyal po mngon sum du byon/ sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa byon nas/ khyod kyis spos phul gsungs nas bdag gis spos phul tho rangs kyi dus su spyan ras gzigs dbang zhal bcu gcig pa'i byin rlabs mdzad pa'i snang ba byung*/

spos phul gsung bas bdag gis spos phul/ smin drug zla ba'i yar tshes drug gi nyin par sgra sna tshogs grag bdag drung na yod pas/ lha khang gi nang na rnam rgyal mchod pa byed mi rnams yin nam zhus pas/ lha khang na rnam rgyal byed pa la bltar song gsung*/ de bltar phyin pas khong rnams kyis kyang sgra thos nas ci yin nam/ khyed zhur song zer bdag gis zhus pas lha'i sun ma mang po byung*/ mchod pa gyis/ da rang gzhan don la 'gro dgos pa yin gsung*/ me tog gi char pa sa la 'bab rgyu med pa nam mkha' la mang po byung*/ tshes bcu gsum gyi nyin par gdugs la bzhugs pa'i dus su/ nyi ma yod 'phro la/ sprin dkar po legs pa cig nar gyis byung*/ nam mkha' la phyag mdzub gtad nas bzhad cig mdzad nas/ khyod kyis e mthong gsung*/ bdag gis mthong*/ shin tu sems dga' ba cig byung zhus pas/ sdig shas chung bar 'dug ste/ 'on kyang sdig pa'i dri ma yod 'dra bas sdig sbyong gyis gsungs/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das seng ge'i khri la 'khor nyan thos dang bcas pa bzhugs pa'i snang ba byung bas spos phul gsung*/ de nas spos phul/ bcu bzhi'i nyin par phyi dro gdugs la bzhugs pa'i dus su/ sprin sngar gyi 'dra ba cig byung*/ dpal kyai rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gsal por gzigs pas spos phul gsungs nas spos phul/ bco lnga'i snga dro yang phyi na bzhugs pa'i dus su sprin sngar gyi 'dra ba cig byung*/ 'jam dbyangs lan gsum gzigs/ yang spos phul/ spos lan gsum phul ba'i rting la/ nga la gzigs nas bzhad cig mdzad/ ci lags zhus pas/ 'jam dbyangs dang byams pa gnyis bgro gling mdzad kyin 'dug gsung*/ de'i tshig kyang gsungs pas brjed/ de'i phyi nyin bskor ba mdzad dus su/ mchog sbyin dpal gyis bzhugs khri cog tse chung chung cig dang*/ bzhugs 'bol cig bzung nas sngon la 'gro/ bdag gi dpung pa g.yas la phyag gis brten nas bzhud/

mchod khang thad sor byon pa dang*/ bzhugs khri de la bzhugs nas/ mchog sbyin dpal/ da khyod ja skol du song gsung*/ bdag la khyod song la spos cig sbyor la shog gsung*/ spos yong ba dang ā yu sta ra gsung*/ sgrol mas zhal gzigs par 'dug tshes bcu bdun gyi nam gung tsam la/ bdag drung na cog ge yod pas/ gzims pa de tsog gis bzhengs nas/ khyod kyis ci yang ma mthong ngam/ klu dbyangs rol mo'i sgra thos sam gsung*/ slob dpon jo ldan dang nged mang rab yod pas rol mo'i sgra thos gzhan ci yang ma mthong zhus pas/ bdag la gzigs te/ bde mchog gis gtso byas pa'i dkyil 'khor bcu gsum gyi snang ba byung gsung*/ dpa' bo dang dpa' mo thams cad kyi glu dang gar mdzad kyin 'dug gsung*/ tshigs bcad mang po cig gsung ba bdag gis ma zin/ slob dpon jo ldan gyis mang rab zin snang ba 'dir ma bris/ gzhan la ma bshad sdig pa bsog pa'i rgyur 'gro gsung*/ ju gur me mar na/ dge bshes rdo rang zer ba cig na zhing yod pas/ bdag gis slob ma rin chen rgyal mtshan bltar btang bas/ bshang lci thams cad mal du btang*/ g.yog po med/ sdug par snang ba'i lo rgyus drung na zlo zhing snang ba dang*/ chos rje'i zhal nas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyang mkhyen bzhin du thugs rjes mi gzigs pa gsung*/ de'i nub mo tho rangs bla ma rje btsun pa dang*/ slob dpon birwa pa dang*/ nag po pa gsum byon nas/ khyod de la yi ma chad/ zag bcas kyi lus 'di la skye rga na 'chi'i chu bo bzhi yod pa yin gsung*/ birwa pas 'dzum pa mdzad/ nag po pas de yin gsung*/ birwa pas thod pa'i bdud rtsi la srin lag gis reg nas/ khyod kyi ljags rkyongs gsungs nas/ ljags la thig le byas pa'i snang ba byung gsung*/ de'i dus su rtog pa dang rtog med mtha' las 'das pa/ bde gsal mi rtog pa rgyal ba rnams kyi thugs la'ang 'di las lhag pa med snyam pa'i snang ba byung*/

de nas bla ma rje btsun pas 'di nas gzhan don la 'gro ba'i dus su/ shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams du ma brgal ba'i pha rol tu mkha' la gnas pa'i rig pa 'dzin par gyur nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa du ma mnyes par byas shing*/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag pa dang*/ sems can du ma yongs su smin par byas nas/ sa dang lam phal cher bgrod de/ skye ba gsum pa la 'dzam bu'i gling 'di nyid kyi rgya gar shar lho mu mu nir zhes bya bar/ rgyal po nyi ma'i stobs 'phel zhes bya ba'i bur 'khrungs nas gzhon nu la rtsom pa dang*/ 'chad pa mang po mdzad/ mngon par shes pas 'jig rten thams cad gzigs nas/ 'khor dad ldan 'bum phrag du ma grol bar byas nas de'i dus su ngas dbang bskur ba dang*/ chos 'brel byas pa tsam thams cad nga yi 'khor du 'ong bar 'dug gsungs pa'i tshig kyang yod/ sku tshe'i tshad kyang yod pa brjed zin/ de nas sku tshe 'phos nas/ sangs rgyas dri ma med pa'i dpal zhes bya ba sku skye ba bzhes nas/ sems can gyi don mdzad par 'dug gsung*/ rje btsun pas birwa pa la de ltar lags sam gsung*/ slob dpon gyis de yin gsung*/ nag po pas kyang de yin gsungs nas mthun 'gyur mdzad/ de nas bdag la tshogs kyi mchod pa shoms shig gsungs te bshams so// de nas zab mo'i lam la nan tan du mdzad pa'i stobs kyis gsang ba'i gnas ltar mi mngon pa dang*/ dbu'i gtsug tor gsal por 'phags pa dang*/ smin mtshams kyi mdzod spu dung ltar 'khyil ba la sogs pa'i sku yon tan dang ldan par gyur to// zla ba bcu gcig pa'i yar tshes bdun la/ sprul pa'i lha khang na tshogs tshad kyis thos pa'i sgra sna tshogs pa'i rol mo grags/ kho bos rgyu mtshan ci lags zhus pas khyed thams cad gsol ba 'debs pa la brtson par gyis gsung*/ lam pha rol tu phyin pa'i lugs la/ mgo dang rkang lag bdog pa thams cad gtong ba bas kyang*/ dbang bskur ba mchog thob pa'i bla ma la/

mos gus dang zhabs tog skad cig tsam byas pa bsod nams che gsung*/ yod tshad bla ma rang la phul bas de'i dus su bdag la 'bul rgyu med pas/ sngon gnas brtan rkang pa bcos pa'i yon du byin pa'i zhwa phrug gi phyam tshe dmar po so ma legs pa cig yod pa de phul nas/ chos rje rang gis bsnams nas yod pas de 'bul dgos snyam pa cig byung bas/ zhal 'dzum pa cig mdzad nas/ de nga la 'bul mi dgos/ de sngar ngas gon pa de phul ba yin/ kho bo byang chub dam pa brnyes pa'i dus su a ru ra lag mthil du bzhag pa bzhin du/ khyed slob ma rnams kyis zhabs tog ci byas thams cad gzigs pa yin/ de'i dbang bskur sems bskyed zhabs tog ci byas pa thams cad dang kho bo mthong zhing rjes su dran pa thams cad dang reg pa dang*/ gtam byas pa dang*/ 'brel pa byas pa thams cad don med par mi 'gyur bar/ ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal las grol ba yin/ des na khyod kyang nga'i zhabs tog mang po byas pas dga' ba sgoms shig gsung*/ bdag gis nub cig srod nas tho rangs kyi cha tshun chad la res sku'i rgyab nas brten/ res sku'i sta zur nas brten pas/ 'dul ba rgyal mtshan la shog gsungs nas/ dpon mo zo rog tas phul ba'i phyam tshe de khyer la shog gsungs nas/ bdag la 'di khyod gon/ 'o cag gnyis tshe snga ma nas 'brel pa mang po yod pa yin gsung*/ khyod dang po nga'i ja 'dren par byas/ de nas mi nyag 'ga' ru jo 'bum gug shrī'i rtsar brdzangs/ der hor gyis ded pa la ma shi bas/ da ltar nga'i zhabs tog mang du byas/ phyi ma la nga'i drung du mi skye kha med yin gsung*/ smal po'i zla ba'i yar tshes bcu bzhi'i tho rangs kyi cha la sna tshogs rgyal mtshan dang*/ rol mo'i sgra dang*/ glu'i mchod pa sna tshogs pa dang sa g.yo ba dang bcas pas zhi bar gshegs par gyur to// nyi shu lnga'i nyin par gdung bzhus pa'i dud pa thams cad kyang 'ja'i rnam par gyur/

rol mo'i sgra mang po yang skye bo'i tshogs pa thams cad kyis thos so// gdung yang phal che ba zhig ring bsrel du gyur to// rdo rje 'chang dbang chen po la// so so skye bor rtog pa 'khrul// dung la ser por mthong dang mtshungs// mdzad pa mdzad kyin byin gyis rlobs// bla ma chos kyi rje sa skya puṇḍi ta chen po'i rnam par thar pa dang*/ bde ba nas bde bar gshegs pa'i dus su lung bstan pa'i rtogs brjod cha 'ga' tsam zhig brjod pa/ de nyid kyi zhabs rdul spyi bos len pa'i rdo rje 'dzin pa blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos sbyar ba las/ slar yang bla ma dmar ston chos kyi rgyal po/ mkhas pa rgyal ba dpal/ bi ji rin chen grags/ dam pa kun dga' grags/ bar ston rdo rje rgyal mtshan rnams kyis mdzad pa'i rnam thar las don tshang bar bsdus te/ sgro skur dang bral ba'i rnam thar gsung sgros ma yongs su rdzogs so// //gsan yig sogs rgyas par dngos grub brnyes pa slob dpon rin chen dpal gyis mdzad pa'i rnam thar du blta'o// //

༄༅// bla ma dam pa grub chen buddha shrī'i rnam par thar pa bzhugs// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti siddhaṃ/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la spyi bos gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// sangs rgyas gsung rab chu gter las 'ongs pa'i// dpal gyi 'byung gnas man ngag yid bzhin nor// tshul bzhin sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan rtser mchod pa// sgrub pa'i dbang phyug dpal ldan bla mar 'dud// gang la lung dang mngon rtogs kyi// rmad byung yon tan rin po che// ji ltar mnga' ba'i rtogs brjod rnams// mtha' gnyis spangs te bshad kyis nyon// bdag gi bla ma lung dang rtogs pa'i yon tan gyi chos mtha' yas pa la dbang 'byor pa'i bdag nyid grub chen buddha shrī zhes rnam par grags pa 'di'i yab ti shrī kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi zhabs 'bring pa chen po gu shrī dpal 'byor legs pa zhes bya ba/ hor yul du dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud 'grel gyi par mdzad pa po de dang*/ yum sgrol ma 'bum zhes pa gnyis kyi sras su sa mo yos kyi lo la/ la stod byang gi phyogs 'brog gi dgon pa sgo phu zhes par 'khrungs/ chung ngu nas bla ma shākya bzang po la dge bsnyen zhus/ tshe dpag med kyi dbang nod de mtshan yang sangs rgyas dpal du btags/ spyod 'jug kha don byed pa'i ma ma cig dang lhan cig tu bzhugs pas gzhung thugs su chud/ klog dang yi ge sogs la sbyangs nas dge bsnyen gyi rten de nyid la sgo phur bshad gsar mdzad/ rang gi zhang po slob dpon dhwa dza shrī la brtag pa gnyis pa'i rgyud dang*/ kye rdo rje'i lag len sogs slob gnyer mang du mdzad/ dgung lo nyi shu rtsa gsum pa la gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇḍi ta chen po chos rje sa bzang pas mkhan po dang*/ mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i lo tsā ba chen po byang chub rtse mos las kyi slob dpon dang*/ sde snod 'dzin pa mkhan chen sangs rgyas bzang po pas gsang ste ston pa'i slob dpon mdzad nas dpal bzang ldan gyi gtsug lag khang du rab tu byung ba dang bsnyen par rdzogs pa dus gcig mdzad de/

sngar gyi mtshan saṃ skṛ tar bsgyur nas buddha shrī zhes par btags so// rab tu byung ba'i dga' ston dang yab rgya yul du gshegs pa'i tshogs gsog rgya chen po mdzad do// de nas mkhan chen shes rab rgya mtsho ba las phar phyin dang mngon pa kun las btus la slob gnyer mdzad cing snga phyir chos mang po gsan/ mkhan chen mgon rgyal ba las rnam 'grel gyi slob gnyer cung zad mdzad cing snga phyir chos du ma gsan/ dpal ldan sa skyar rtog ge pa dpal ldan bzang po shangs pa blo mchog tu grags pa las rnam 'grel gyi slob gnyer mdzad pa nyi thog gi las tshab dang 'chad nyan sogs dgung lo sum cu so gcig gi bar la mdzad do// de dag gi bar la chos rje kun mkhyen chen po las ma ṇi'i lung*/ chos rje sa bzang paṇḍi ta las dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang*/ yum rgyas pa'i lung la sogs pa dang*/ 'jig rten dbang phyug gi sprul pa'i sku rgyal sras thogs med las de nyid kyis mdzad pa'i blo sbyong don bdun ma/ rten 'brel snying po/ skyid sdug lam khyer rnams kyi khrid/ sems bskyed lugs gnyis ka'i cho ga smyung gnas kyi cho ga rnams zhus/ lo tsā ba chen po byang chub rtse mo las gsang 'dus rim lnga'i dmar khrid de nyid kyis mdzad pa/ rgyal sras rin po che'i bka' 'bum 'thor bu ba/ bsnyung gzhi la phan pa'i phyir du rdo za ba'i man ngag rnams zhus shing nad zhi bar byin gyis brlab pa mdzad do// dus kyi 'khor lo pa chen po phyogs las rnam rgyal las dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud 'grel gyi bshad pa nod/ rdo rje 'chang chen po'i sprul pa'i sku rgyal ba brag phug pa chen po'i slob ma chos rje dkon mchog rgyal mtshan pa las sa lugs kyi rdo rje 'jigs byed/ gshed dmar lha bcu gsum ma/ sgrol ma lha bcu bdun ma/ 'khor lo bde mchog lus kyi dkyil 'khor rnams su dbang bskur ba rnams zhus shing*/

mos gus dang byin rlabs tshad med pa thugs rgyud la 'khrungs so// gzhan yang skyes bu dam pa mang po las dam pa'i chos mang du gsan cing*/ gtso cher rnam 'grel gyi slob gnyer la rtsol ba drag po mdzad do// sngon yab mkhan por song bas de la sras byung na zhabs 'dren che bsam nas/ yum gyis rje nyid mngal du zhugs pa'i tshe/ sbyor sman mang du btang ba'i mthus sku lus shin tu ngan/ pho ba la nad drag po skabs 'ga' rer zug rngu bzod brlag med pa 'byung ba cig yod/ de la lha rje sogs kyis kyang cher ma phan pa la/ rgyus yod 'ga' zhig na re/ mus kyi mkhar steng na ma gcig chos sgron zer ba'i sgrub pa mo mngon shes can khyad par 'phags pa cig yod/ des nad pa mang po la phan gyin 'dug zer nas der byon pas/ khyed kyi 'di sngon las su gda' bas phug sangs rang mi 'gro/ 'phral slob gnyer la mi gnod pa tsam cig 'ong lags kyi gsungs nas/ gcod nam mkha' sgo 'byed cig bstan/ de ka rgyun du ma chags par mdzod/ da slob gnyer la gnod pas 'dir ma bzhugs par byon/ spyir slob dpon nyid thugs dam cig mdzad na legs par gda' gsungs/ dmigs pa de rnams mdzad pas sngar bas cung drag par gyur nas slob gnyer la 'bad pa chen po mdzad de/ sku lus sdug bsngal ba'i ngang nas rnam 'grel gyi slob gnyer mthar phyin te/ dpal ldan sa skyar grwa skor mdzad nas nyi thog gi las pa dang chud kha'i 'chad nyan rnams mdzad do// de nas byi ba'i lo la bla ma chos sgron can na byon nas phyag rgya chen po lhan cig skyes sbyor cig zhus/ thog med pa'i rtsig skyor cig tu bsgom pas nyams myong bzang po skyes/ sbyor drug gi rtags snang phal cher de dus shar 'dug zer/ 'jig rten gyi snang ba la zhen log dang nyams len kho na byas dgos snyam pa'i blo drag po 'khrungs/ mkhar steng du tshe dang sgrub pa mnyam par bya snyam yang ma gcig na re/

da len sa skyar byon mdzod/ der 'jam dbyangs kyi sprul pa cig la man ngag chen po bzhi'i myong brgyud la skye ba'i rten 'brel 'grig man ngag de rnams dngos su ston mkhan gyi bla ma cig dang las bzang po'i 'brel pa tshud par gda' bas cis kyang byon gsungs nas sa skyar byon pas/ rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab chos kyi rje dpal ldan bla ma dam pa nyid bo dong gi chos 'khor tshar nas sa skyar phebs pa dang 'dzom/ mjal tu phyin pas 'gro mgon chos rje zhwa lu khang gsar nas shing khang bla brang du chos gsung du 'byon gyin 'dug pa la byin rlabs zhus pas/ dpon chen dbang phyug dpal zhal ta cig zhu ba dang thug nas khong zhal ta de zhu ma tshar bar la sgrol ma tshar gcig 'don ring tsam cig byung ba de bar rje nyid kyi phyag gis bla ma'i dbu skrar bzung nas bzhugs pas dga' spro khyad par can skyes/ phyi nang gi rten 'brel gyi gnad cig de nas 'grig chos rje nyid 'jam dbyangs dngos yin thag chod snyam pa'i dad pa shugs can 'khrungs/ de nas shing khang du chos 'brel zhus pas gsung ngag rin po che'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor la 'pho ba dang bar do'i man ngag zhib mo cig nan tan mdzad nas gnang*/ de dus sbyor drug gi dmigs pa zhu tshar ba'i dge bshes 'ga' zhig la chos rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i ngo sprod chen mo gsung gin 'dug pa la de thob par 'dod nas/ khrid gnyer la bla ma dam pa dpal ldan tshul khrims pa 'dug pa la zhu ba bskur bas/ khyod kyis khrid e thob gsungs pas/ ma thob byas pas 'o na mi 'ong*/ zhu dgos zer nas zhu ba bya gsung*/ rgyu mtshan zhus pas khar sang yun ring byin rlabs zhu mkhan de yin na bya gsungs nas/ bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam thar yan chad song 'dug de man chad rdzogs par gnang*/ de dus khrid ma thob kyang snang ba de da lta sbyor drug gi myong ba cung zad tsam 'ong ba de mkhyen par 'dug gsungs/

gzhan mang pos chos 'brel du zhu yin 'dug nas sum pa lo tsā ba'i blo sbyong thob/ yang lan cig nyang stod mag pa'i dge slong gnyis kyis zhus pa'i zhar la gsang 'dus rim lnga'i nyams len rgyas pa cig thob/ de rnams kyi rten 'brel gyis phyis chos rje dpal ldan tshul khrims las gsung ngag rin po che/ rim lnga/ sbyor drug gsum gyi man ngag rgyas par thob pa dang de gsum la go myong che se ba yod pa 'di dang*/ gzhan re re tsam la phan pa cung zad byung ba yin gsungs/ gzhan yang 'gro mgon chos kyi rje de nyid las snga sor dbu ma lugs kyi sems bskyed kyi cho ga lan gsum/ rnam 'grel/ dus 'khor/ rgyal sras lam bzang rnams kyi chos thun 'ga' re gsan/ dus phyis sbrul gyi lo la dpal sa skyar chos rje dpal ldan tshul khrims pa la shar stod kyi gzims khang du dpal kye'i rdo rje'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du rgyu dus kyi dbang bskur ba zhus nas gsung ngag rin po che'i khrid gzhung bshad sogs man ngag phal cher rdzogs pa cig zhus/ bla ma la dad pa dang man ngag la yid ches bsam gyis mi khyab pa skyes gsungs/ phyis rje dpal ldan tshul khrims pa la stod byang pas gdan drangs nas dgon pa mkha' spyod na bzhugs dus phyin nas yang gsung ngag rin po che'i bka' lung phal cher tshar gcig zhus/ nyams myong bzang po kha cig skyes pas yid spro nas sgom 'jur po byas pas nyams kyi sna zin tsam byung*/ yang phyis zhi dgon ri khrod du spyan drangs/ lo gcig dang zla ba lnga bzhugs/ longs spyod kyi zhabs tog kyang bsam gyis mi khyab pa phul nas zhus pas/ gsung ngag rin po che'i smin grol gyi lam yongs su rdzogs pa/ gzhung ji lta ba bzhin gyi khrid thad ka'i nyams rdzogs pa thon thon gyi bar du bsgoms shing*/ brdar sha bcad nas zhus pas man ngag mtha' dag rdzogs par gnang*/ de dus kye rdo rje lus dkyil gyi dbang zhus pa'i tshe/

lus la bde drod dang sems la gsal stong gi ye shes cung zad skyes/ dbang de zin pa'i tshogs 'khor gyi gral du skyug 'dod pa cig byung*/ bsran pas ma thub nas khrag sha dud mdog can chen po gsum byung*/ de rjes gnas gzhan du phyin nas skyugs pas dri nga la skyug bro ba'i khrag mang po 'thon/ de phyin chad sngar gyi bsnyung gzhi de rnams las grol te sku gzugs bzang ba'i mchog cig byung ngo*// mdor na bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims nyid kyis/ bla ma dam pa blo gros brtan pa dang*/ 'gro mgon chos kyi rje nyid dang*/ grub chen dkar po brag pa rin chen seng ge gsum las ji ltar gsan pa'i gsung ngag rin po che dang 'brel pa'i dbang*/ bshad pa/ khrid/ gegs sel/ man ngag phra mo tshun chad kyi bar yongs su rdzogs par zhus pas dbang gi chu bo ma nub/ byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ma nyams/ gdams ngag gi sarga ma log mos gus kyi bsam pa tshim pa ste snyan brgyud bzhi'i byin gyis brlabs shing gdams pas/ brjod bral lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mtshon byed dpe'i tshul du thugs rgyud la 'khrungs so// rje dpal ldan tshul khrims pas gsung ngag rin po che'i man ngag phal cher rdzogs par gnang ba'i slob ma mang du yod kyang*/ nyid la ji ltar mnga' ba bzhin gyi gdams ngag phran tshegs dang bcas pa ma lus par gnang ba ni/ bla ma dam pa 'di nyid dang*/ bla ma dam pa mkhas pa'i dbang phyug ye shes rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po dang*/ mi nyag gi ston pa rin chen rdo rje dang gsum kho na yin gsungs/ mdor na gnas de nyid du gsung ngag gi chos skor rdzogs par mdzad nas/ sgrub pa lung sbyin pa'i tshe/ khyod la tshe ring po dang rtogs pa bzang po 'ong bas nyams len la 'bad pa thon/ phyi dus slob ma 'ga' zhig la'ang phan pa 'byung gsungs/ yang gsang ba 'dus pa mi bskyod rdo rje sa lugs kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba zhus nas bskyed rim mdor byas kyi lung bshad tsam cig dang*/

rdzogs rim lam rim pa lnga'i gdams ngag bla ma nyid kyis 'gro mgon chos rje dang*/ thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston las nos pa'i dmar khrid kyi gdams ngag ngo sprod dang bcas pa dang gser sdings pa las brgyud pa'i nag khrid du grags pa'i man ngag rab tu mang po rnams dang*/ rgya pho ba lung pa'i man ngag bla ma mar pa'i rim lnga bsdus gsal pho ba lung pa'i 'grel pa dang bcas pa dang*/ rngog lugs kyi mchog dbang gong ma gsum gyi cho ga dang*/ bla ma bo dong pa nam mkha' dpal las nos pa'i rdo rje gdan gyi nag po pa/ btsun mo can/ mngon shes can gsum gyi gdams ngag 'gos kyi shog dril gsum mar grags pa dang*/ bla ma tshul khrims rgyal mtshan las nos pa'i gsang 'dus lus dkyil gyi dbang bskur du grags pa rnams gsan zhing bsgom pas/ rmi lam sbyang ba dang*/ spel bsgyur mang po nus pa dang*/ 'od gsal dang*/ zung 'jug gi rtogs pa khyad par can rgyud la 'khrungs so// yang dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i nges don gyi dkyil 'khor du mchog dbang gong ma bzhi zhus nas zab lam rdo rje rnal 'byor sbyor ba yan lag drug pa'i nyams len gyi khrid bla ma nyid kyis 'gro mgon chos rje las nos pa'i brgyud pa so so'i gdams ngag rab tu mang po dang*/ rgya gar gyi sbyor drug gi gzhung du ma dang*/ dbang mdor bstan/ dpal nā ro pa'i 'grel pa'i bshad pa dang bcas pa dang*/ grub chen sron lung pa'i man ngag rab tu mang po dang*/ yang bla ma rin chen dbang phyug las nos pa'i sbyor drug dbang rgyal lugs su grags pa'i gdams ngag zhal shes dang*/ lag len rab tu mang po dang bcas pa dang*/ bu ston chos rje las nos pa'i sbyor drug gi khrid yig ngo sprod rnams te mdor na bla ma 'di nyid la mnga' ba'i sbyor ba yan lag drug pa'i gdams ngag bod na bzhugs pa phal che ba mnga' ba rnams gsan cing bsgoms pas mtshan mo'i rnal 'byor gyi skabs su phyi rol gyi khang pa la sogs pa'i dngos po 'ga' zhig mun khang gi nang nas gsal por mthong ba sogs pa gsal snang gi yon tan gyi khyad par 'ga' zhig skyes gsung ngo*// gzhan yang 'khor lo bde mchog lus kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba/

sgrol ma lus kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba/ kun rig tshe dpag tu med pa/ gzungs grwa lnga rnams kyi dbang bskur ba zhus/ rje btsun nā ro ta pa'i thugs dam mkha' spyod ma'i byin rlabs zhus nas de dag gi bskyed rim gyi gdams ngag yan lag dang bcas pa dang*/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa rtsa dbu ma'i man ngag rnams gsan nas thugs nyams su bzhes so// gzhan yang dpal rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa lha brgyad dang*/ las mgon pu ṭa rnams kyi rjes gnang bka' bsgo dang bcas pa dang*/ mgon po gdong bzhi pa'i rjes su gnang ba rnams zhus shing*/ man ngag rnams rdzogs par mdzad do// yang gtsug tor rnam rgyal/ sa lugs kyi don zhags gtso rkyang gi rjes gnang chos skor dang bcas pa dang*/ rtsa rgyud brtag pa gnyis pa/ bshad rgyud rdo rje gur/ dpal sambu ṭa rnams kyi lung tsam zhig gsan to// gzhan yang bla ma yang dgon pa'i ri chos cha lag 'ga' zhig dang bcas pa dang*/ bla ma shangs pa'i ni gu chos drug yan lag dang bcas pa rnams kyang gsan cing thugs su chud par mdzad do// de ltar dge ba'i bshes gnyen dam pa rnams bsten nas thos bsam sgom gsum gyi shes rab rgyas par mdzad pa/ mkhyen pa'i ye shes tshad med pa mnga' ba yin no// gzhan yang bdag cag gi bla ma thugs rje chen po 'di ni mnyam gzhag tu sems can thams cad drin can pha mar gzigs nas/ de rnams la byams pa dang*/ snying rje dang*/ bdag gzhan brje ba'i byang chub kyi sems rgyun ldan du bsgoms pas rjes thob tu gzhan dbul po dang*/ nad dang*/ sdug bsngal gyis gzir ba rnams la phan pa kho na sgrub par mdzad do// yul gzhan thag ring por nad dang sdug bsngal gyis nyen pa gsan na/ de la dmigs te bdag gzhan brje ba'i byang sems mang por mdzad la de tsam thugs long ma byung na brgya rtsa re mdzad pa srol du snang ngo*// de ltar byang chub kyi sems rgyun du sbyangs pas brtse ba'i thugs rje bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i yon tan mnga' ba yin no// gzhan 'gro ba mang po la zang zing gi sbyin pa'i sgo nas kyang phan par mdzad de/

rje nyid kyi yab hor yul du byon pas dngos po bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod kyang de dag la 'dzin pa cung zad kyang mi mnga' phal cher yab yum gnyis kyi don du rdzogs par mdzad cing*/ bar skabs su chud kha'i chab 'og tu mu ge byung ba'i tshe/ dngul bre chen cig gis thog drangs ba'i nang nor yongs su rdzogs pa chud kha sde pa la btsongs nas rin gyi nas rnams kyis sems can bkren pas gzir ba rnams tshim par byas pa dang*/ bde bar gshegs pa'i lo gsum gyi gong du zhing gzhis gang yod rnams btsongs nas de dag gi cha rkyen rnams dge 'dun skye bo'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la phul nas mthar chos kyi sku mngon du mdzad pa na/ rdo rje dril bu dang nang mchod dang bcas pa'i mchod cha cung zad cig dang*/ rnam sbyar/ lhung bzed/ na bza' nyung zad cig bzhugs gdan dbu rten dang bcas pa cig ma gtogs gser se ba gcig gam/ nas khal gcig tu longs pa med par sbyin pa gtang ba yin/ bye brag tu ting nge 'dzin don du gnyer ba'i gang zag byung na zas gos kyi phan pa lhur mdzad do// de bzhin du bsam gtan la blo kha ma phyogs pa'i gang zag rnams la ting nge 'dzin gyi phan yon dang bstan pa la bya ba tshul bzhin bsgrub pa de chos shes nas nyams su len pa 'di kho na yin no zhes snyan par smra ba'i tshig yang dang yang du gsungs pas/ gdul bya de dag ting nge 'dzin nyams su len pa la 'jug par mdzad do// gdul bya ting nge 'dzin la dad par byas zin pa'i gang zag thun mong pa rnams la theg pa chen po'i blo sbyong don bdun ma/ lam rnam par nges pa/ ka ma la shī la'i dbu ma sgom rim rnams ji ltar 'tsham par gsungs la/ thun mong gi lam gyis rgyud sbyangs pa'i gang zag rnams la/ gsungs ngag sbyor drug gsang 'dus rim lnga rnams ji ltar 'os par gsungs pas/ gdul bya'i rgyud ting nge 'dzin la longs spyod du 'jug par mdzad do// gdul bya gzhan la man ngag bstan pa ltar rang nyid kyang nyams su len te/

gsung ngag sngon ma zhus nas da nyams len la dril dgos 'dra snyam pa'i 'dun pa skyes pa na/ mtshan cig mnal lam na zhi dgon gyi ri la 'dzegs nas khang chung cig tu phyin pas/ de na rje btsun ga ya dha ra yin snyam pa'i paṇḍi ta dkar po cig na re/ lam gyi thun bzhi la dbang bzhi bsgoms pas lus la brten nas bde chen gyi sgrib pa 'gag cing 'tshang rgya bar gsal bas/ bshad rgyud ces pa'i gzhung de 'don cing 'dug pa gsal ba cig rmis/ sad pa dang de ltar bsdad pa 'thad pa yin dgongs te/ zhi dgon ri khrod la mkhar las mdzad nas bde bar ma gshegs bar la gnas de nyid du bzhugs nas 'du 'dzi dang rnam g.yeng thams cad spangs te/ nyams len kho na la dril nas bzhugs pas nyams rtogs khyad par can rgyud la 'khrungs shing*/ de'i rgyud thugs dam la brtson par mdzad de/ de yang tho rangs ldang ba'i rnal 'byor gyis bzhengs nas skyabs 'gro mang du mdzad/ de nas spyod 'jug nas 'byung ba'i sems bskyed rgyas pa re len/ de nas lam zab bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang*/ de kho na nyid la sems 'jog pa'i skabs su yun ring du mnyam par bzhag 'dir sbyor drug pa'i sor sdud kyi ting nge 'dzin ji lta ba bzhin skye yin 'dug pas lus gnad sbyor drug bzhin byas gsungs/ de nas tshe dpag med kyi rnal 'byor re mdzad pas/ mdun du tshe dpag med bsgoms nas gzungs brgya rtsa re/ sngags thung ba lnga brgya re bzlas par mdzad do// de nas dpal kye rdo rje'i bskyed rim yan lag drug pa lus kyi dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa bsgoms nas lam dus kyi dbang rgyas pa re len/ de nas dbang bzhi bsdus pa'i lam khyad par can bzhi'i nyams len rdzogs pa mdzad/ de yang lo kha cig lta ba bskyang pa gtso bor byas/ rjes la rlung gtum mo bskyed rim gsum la gtso bor byas gsungs/ rjes la bzlas pa aṣṭa brgya lnga bcu re bzlas nas dkyil 'khor bsdus nas bsngo ba sogs rdzogs par mdzad de/

de nas sgom khang nas thon nas lam 'bras brgyud pa'i phyag 'tshal/ dkar gtor cha bzhi/ dzambha la'i chu sbyin/ dbyu gu ma dang mi g.yo ba drug cu rtsa bzhi/ sgrol ma nyer gcig gtor ma brgya rtsa/ thugs rje chen po'i brul gtor cha gsum dang kha don mang du mdzad de/ kha zas kyi rnal 'byor dang ldan pas zas la longs spyod/ mthar mdo dang bsngo ba mang du mdzad nas man ngag bsgom pa rnams bskor ba/ dmigs pa spong ba chos gsungs pa sogs mdzad do// de nas bde mchog dril bu pa'i bskyed rim/ 'jam dbyangs a ra pa tsa na/ sgrol ma tshar nyer gcig re/ khro phu lo tsā ba'i smon lam rin po che'i ljon shing rnams mdzad do// dgung thun la bab pa na/ dpal kye rdo rje'i mngon rtogs bsdus pa lus dkyil lam dus kyi dbang bsdus pa dang bcas pa rtsa sngags phyed dang nyis brgya re dang bcas pa dang*/ ku ru kulle/ seng ge sgra/ khyung khra/ nā ro mkha' spyod rnams kyi sgom bzlas re mdzad/ spyod 'jug gi bsngo ba'i le'u tshar re mdzad/ dgongs thun la bab pa na dpal kye rdo rje'i bskyed rim rdzogs pa/ lam dus kyi dbang rgyas pa rtsa sngags brgya rtsa re dang bcas pa sngon du btang nas mdun bskyed sgrub cing mchod pa/ gtor ma dang po kye rdor/ gnyis pa bde mchog gsum pa nā ro mkha' spyod rnams la phul nas/ chos skyong che chung*/ pu tra rnams kyi gtor ma rgyas pa dang*/ dpa' bo'i ston mo tshul bzhin rdzogs par mdzad do// de nas khro phu lo tsā ba'i smon lam legs bzhi ma 'don no// de nas dkon mchog gi spyan sngar phyag mchod rgyas pa mdzad nas sgom khang du zhugs te/ kye rdo rje'i phyi nang gi bskyed rim bsdus pa/ lam dus su dbang blang ba'i cho ga rnams sngon du btang nas/ rlung sbyor dang gtum mo'i dmigs pa kha spos nas gang rung re rnams bsgoms pas bde drod dang*/ de la brten nas lta ba rnam par dag pa thugs rgyud la 'khrungs shing*/

de la yun ring du 'jog pa sogs kyi sgo nas nam phyed kyi bar dus 'das nas mthar 'khrul 'khor dang lus sbyong mang du mdzad de nyal ba'i rnal 'byor la gnas par mdzad do// de ltar sku tshe khor yug tu thugs dam 'ba' zhig gis dus 'da' zhing*/ thun bar la gdul bya skal ldan 'ga' la man ngag zab mo rnams ting nge 'dzin skyes khrid kyi tshul gyis gtan la 'bebs pa sogs sku tshe rang po bshad sgrub kyis dus 'da' ba zhig go /de dag gi bar skabs su man ngag zab mo yi ger bkod pa yang 'ga' zhig yod de/ 'gro mgon chos kyi rje la gsol ba gdab pa/ bla ma dam pa dpal ldan tshul khrims la gsol ba gdab pa/ mkhan chen shes rab rgya mtsho'i gdung mchod dus kyi gsol ba 'debs pa/ bla ma dam pa dpal ldan tshul khrims kyi rnam thar/ gsung ngag rin po che'i khrid yig lam 'bras gzhung bshad dang gegs sel gyi zin bris/ 'chi ltas brtag pa'i gdams ngag tshigs bcad ma/ grub chen bcu dang phra mo brgyad kyi zhal shes/ phrin las so gnyis kyi sdom tshig sbyor drug gi khrid yig sron lugs kyi rlung sbyor sogs kyi zin bris/ dbang rgyal ba'i sbyor drug gi zhal shes yi ger bkod pa/ khrid zhu spyi la gdams pa/ tshe sgrub kyi gdams ngag dbu ma'i gzhi lam 'bras gsum rnams mdzad do// dgung lo bdun cu don gcig pa byi ba lo nag pa'i zla ba la bdag rje nyid kyi drung du sleb ste/ de dus sgom chen cig gis blo sbyong zhus/ don dam byang chub sems kyi skabs su zhi gnas bsgom du bcug pas rnam rtog khegs ma nus pa zhig byung ba la bsam gtan gyi bag chags med pa snying rje gsungs nas mdun du bzhag lus gnad byed du bcug nas khyod rang nga'i sna rtse 'di la mig ma yengs par ltos shig gsungs/ rje nyid lus gnad mdzad de/ spyan 'bru tshugs su mdzad de kho'i snying ga'i thad du gzigs nas/ tsha ba tshar ba nas gro ma ran tsam gyi bar du bzhugs pas kho la lus nyams dang ngag nyams mang po zhig byung*/

de'i rjes sems zin nas ting nge 'dzin mang po skyes te sgom chen bzang po cig byung 'dug go /yang sgom chen cig smyo nas bla ma gzhan gnyis tsam la gtugs na yang ye ma phan zer ba zhig rje nyid kyi drung du khrid byung bas/ sngar ko brag pas smyo pa cig la 'di 'dra byas pas phan bya ba 'dug rang re kyang e phan blta gsungs nas/ mi de la khyod rang rlung nyi shu rtsa gcig bus/ dge slong rin blos grangs 'dzin dang bskul mkhan gyis gsungs/ khos rlung re bus pa dang*/ bla mas rlung rngub thengs re mdzad kyi snang*/ nyer gcig song ba dang bskad sa'i sgor byon nas rlung btang ste gzims khang du byon song*/ kho'i smyo ba de 'phral la sangs nas/ dril bu pa'i dbang bskur zhig dang*/ gur mgon gyi rjes gnang zhig zhus nas song ngo*// yang kham pa dge bshes cig la khams 'dzag pa'i gegs thu mo cig 'dug pa rgyu mtshan zhus pas ci yang ma gsung*/ nang par kha sang gi dge bshes de khrid shog gdon gyis 'dzag par 'dug gsungs nas mi de la byin rlabs dang dmigs pa 'dra mdzad kyin 'dug pas bar chad de las grol lo// de la sogs pa dge sbyor ma skyes pa bskyed pa dang*/ gegs sel la dbang thob pa cig snang ngo*// yang sbyor drug gsung dus zhig stong gzugs 'di bskyed rim rtog bsgom la mi 'char bar gsungs 'dug kyang nges pa cher med pa 'dra/ ngas tho rangs tshe sgrub byed kyin yod pa de dus mdun du tshe dpag med bsgoms pas/ sprul sku'i rnam pa khri dang bcas pa ji ltar bsgoms pa bzhin 'char/ de la mchod pa 'bul ba'i dmigs pa byas pas me tog mar me lha bshos sogs kyis nyal khang gi nang khrig ge gang bar song de dang po theng re theng gnyis 'char ba byung*/ da dus phyis rtag tu 'ong gin 'dug stong gzugs su ni gda' gsungs/ glang lor lam 'bras gsungs dus shig man ngag 'di pa'i lugs kyi rjes thob tu ngo bo nyid gsum skyong tshul 'di zab po rang cig 'dug

'di ka la dran 'dzin ma chad par byas tsa na dge sbyor dga' mo 'ong gin 'dug gsungs/ chos de grol rjes bdag gis rjes thob lam khyer ji ltar mdzad zhus pas/ ngas spros pa tsam ma byas par bsgoms pas/ de rjes thob tu grogs med gcig pur bsdad tsa na/ snang ba thams cad nyams snang 'ba' zhig tu 'char/ de las gzhan du sems mi g.yo ba zhig 'ong*/ mi cig rtsar 'byung ba'am/ thugs sgra sogs byung tsa na khang khyim sogs snang ba rang dga' ma 'di 'char/ yang cung zad nas nyams snang du 'gro ba zhig byung*/ de lam 'bras pa'i ngo bo nyid gsum skyong tshul de ka la nyams len byas pa'i 'bras bur 'dug gsungs/ de la sogs pa rtogs pa'i yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba zhig go /yang dus cig bde mchog 'di lam khyad 'phags cig yin par 'dug ngas chos rje dpal ldan pa la dril bu pa'i dbang thob nas ye ma yengs par bsgoms/ nā ro mkha' spyod kyi byin rlabs zhus nas bsgom bzlas byas pas rdzogs rim gyi rtogs pa skye bar phan par byung gsungs/ dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma rnams kyang ji ltar bsgos pa'i phrin las sgrub bar snang ste/ dus cig zhi dgon pa'i g.yag bdun rkun mas khyer 'dug pa/ de nub gtor ma bsngo ba'i skabs su mon bu pu tra g.yag ded pa ma shi ba zhig gyis/ rkun ma rnams kyi srog la gnod pa ma skyel/ tsham rngam gyis la 'jigs su chug ces gsung skad chen pos lan gsum gsung gin snang*/ phyis zhag gsum song dus 'jigs med zer ba'i spyi pa cig 'dug pa de la/ chu 'og pa'i mi cig na re khyed kyi g.yag bor ba nged kha cig gis rnyed yod pas 'bul zer/ gtam mang du byas pas bla ma'i byin rlabs dang chos skyong gi gtor dbang dgos/ phyis chos skyong gi gnod pa mi yong ba'i srung 'khor dgos zer nas g.yag bdun ka bskyal song*/ cho 'phrul 'ga' zhig byung bar snang ngo*// dbon po shes rab seng ge la khong nad thu mo cig yod pa la gcod kyi dmigs pa byed du bcug pas cher ma phan pa/

'byung po cig gi bar chad cig yin pa 'dra/ gur mgon gyi rjes gnang zhig zhus gsungs/ nyi shu dgu zhig la zhus pas bka' bsgo byed pa'i 'di'i dus su bar chad zhi bar gyis gsungs pa'i tshe lus nyams byung ste rdo rje skyil krung du bzhugs bzhin pa la/ gtor ma phyag tu bzung nas 'phar te khong gi lus steng du 'phags pa byung*/ de kas nad gzhi de las grol/ de la sogs pa ji ltar bka' bsgos pa bzhin du sgrub pa'i lo rgyus mang du snang ngo*// stag gi lo la da lo sa skyar 'gro/ da lan mi sleb gsungs nas byon/ sa skya sa bzang gnyis su zla ba dgu bzhugs/ de'i tshe sgo rum du dpal rdo rje nag po chen po'i sku la shel rgyan dang na bza' dang gtor ma cod paṇa mang po phul nas gsol ba btab pas/ sa skya pa cung drag tu 'gro ba'i rten 'brel cig 'dug gsungs/ de'i tshe sde snod mtha' dag gi dbang phyug mkhas pa'i dbang po chos rje sangs rgyas dpal ba la sogs pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang pos dbang bka' dang khrid dang man ngag mang du zhus/ bdag gis 'ang chos zhu 'phro thams cad rdzogs par mdzad nas/ da sems bde gsungs nas ri khrod du byon no// yos lo nas lo gsum du sku mtshams dam par mdzad/ dge bshes gal chen re re tsam la 'dod chos sna re tsam gnang ba ma gtogs nyin mtshan khor yug tu ting nge 'dzin bsgom pas rtogs pa bzang po 'khrungs so// rta lo la bdag gis lo gcig tsam nas dbus na phyin na 'chi'am zhus pas/ khyed na ning nas kyang yang yang 'gro zer gyin 'dug na'ang*/ nged la chos rje dpal ldan tshul khrims kyi gnang ba'i gdams ngag 'di rnams thams cad khyod la rdzogs pa cig 'phrod na snyam pa de snga ma tshar ba dang*/ chos rje 'phags pa'i sku tshe ci 'dra yong mi shes 'dug pas sdod byas pa yin/ da lan song dbus su lo bzhi 'gor bar 'dug rten 'brel dga' mo cig byung bas bar chad mi 'ong*/

nga yang ma 'chi tsam dang 'phrad par 'dug gsungs nas sku mtshams sngar bas dam du btang*/ thugs dam la dril bas rdzogs rim gyi rtogs pas bsam gyis mi khyab pa thugs rgyud la 'khrungs so// bya lo zla ba lnga pa la bdag gis dbus nas sa skyar sleb dus/ rje nyid sku khams bsnyel po yod zer ba thos/ de 'phral mjal du phyin pas dgon pa'i rtsar slebs pa dang*/ nye gnas nam mkha' mgon bsu ba la byung*/ bdag gis nga yong ba su las tshor byas pas/ gzhan su la yang ma tshor/ khar sang zla ba snga ma nas bla mas sa skyar sleb yod/ grabs gyis yang yang gsungs/ khyad par khar sang de ring gnyis byar gyis gsungs nas byas pa lags zer/ slebs 'phral sku mdun du mjal bas sku bsnyel po rang las mi 'dug na yang shin tu mnyes/ ja mang du gsol/ gsung gleng mang du mdzad/ sang tsha ba'i dus su/ khar sang zla ba snga ma'i tshes lnga'i nub rmi lam bzhin za zi cig la 'gro mgon chos rje byon nas khyod rang gi slob ma de tshes brgyad la sleb yong ba yod/ khos gsol ba btab na da dung lo bzhi mi 'chi gsung ba cig byung*/ de don gyis khyod sleb bam snyam pa da slebs pa legs/ do nub tshes brgyad yin pa 'dra bas khyod kyis mgon po gdong bzhi pa'i bskang gso zhig gyis/ zhing skyong 'dis na ning nas lam sgrub pa'i grogs khyad 'phags zhig byas gsungs/ spyir phyi nang gi rten 'brel 'di ngo mtshar che ba cig 'dug khar sang ja 'thungs pa dang*/ lab mang bas khams zlog gam snyam pa byung*/ nam mgon yang de skad zer gyin 'dug na'ang*/ da phan 'dug gsung*/ de nyin ja dang gsung gling mang du zhus/ nyin phyed tsam dus bdag gi drung nas na ning nas thugs dam 'phel po byung gda'/ bskyed rdzogs kyi rtogs pa rnams sngar dang khyad ci tsam 'phel/ stong gzugs rnams brtan po bdog gam zhus pas/ stong gzugs phra chil chil de da sgom khang du bsdad ma bsdad 'dra bar 'dug

bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyi rtogs pa gzhan de ka la yod gsungs/ cung zad cig nas zhal 'dzum pa mdzad nas/ bdag gi rna ba g.yon pa nas phyag g.yas pas 'then te gsang gros kyi tshul du gsung chung ngu mdzad nas/ ang ke/ ang ke/ na ning nas dge sbyor 'phel po byung*/ bshang gci'i gseb na sems can sogs ye med/ lus la shig med/ dmyal bar song na'ang dga' ste/ snyam pa yod gsungs/ de dus bdag gi rtog pa la ci gsung ba yin nam/ bshang gci'i nang du su yis g.yeng ba ni med snyam pa byung*/ sang tho rangs bsam pas/ sher phyin gyi 'grel par/ dge ba'i rtsa ba 'jig rten las mngon par 'phags pa nyid kyi lus la srin bu'i rigs brgyad khri mi 'byung ba dang*/ dge ba'i rtsa ba rnam par dag pas sems gya gyu med pa dang*/ rnyed pa dang bkur sti la sogs pa la mi lta ba nyid kyis phyag dar khrod pa nyid la sogs pa sbyong ba'i yon tan yang dag par len pa dang*/ sbyin pa la sogs pa'i khyad par bsgrubs pas/ de dag dang 'gal ba ser sna dang*/ 'chal ba'i tshul khrims la sogs pa med pa dang*/ chos thams cad yang dag par sdud pa nyid kyis chos nyid dang mi 'gal bar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang ldan par 'gro ba dang*/ 'gro ba bdag nyid kyi byas pa nyid kyis gzhan gyi don du dmyal bar 'dod pa zhes bya ba rnam pa drug dang zhes pa'i gzhung de dran pas dad pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa skyes/ sbyor lam rtse mo'i ye shes skyes par zhal gyis bzhes par go zhing thag chod do// tshes bcu'i nyin gdan bzhugs kyi gsol 'debs dang*/ sku rim mang rab cig byas/ chos rje nyid kyi chag phyi bdag cag bdun gyis bgyis nas/ bde mchog dril bu pa'i sgrub mchod byas/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams la gtor ma rgya chen po phul zhing gsol ba btab ste/ dbon po shes rab seng ge na re lo brgya'i bar du bzhugs dgos zhu yin 'dug pas/ lo brgya tsam sdod mkhan su yod/

tshe ring po yin/ da lan bla mas ma slebs na shi nyen 'dug na'ang rten 'brel gyis khong slebs/ da shi rung 'gyod pa dang*/ sems kyi 'khri ba cig kyang med/ nga khar sang 'gro mgon chos rjes lo bzhi mi 'chi gsung ba yang byung*/ khyed rnam pa'i de ring phul ba'i gdan 'di la'ang bzhi 'dug pas lo bzhi sdod/ de nas phyin pa drag gsungs/ de nas bdag sku mdun du zla ba gcig bsdad/ phyag rdzas phal cher chos phyogs su btang tshar nas mi 'dug lhag ma 'dug pa rnams nye gnas sogs la gnang sbyin dgos pa/ dge bshes tha dad la phyag dpe/ mchod cha sogs gang 'os rnams mos gus kyi rten du gnang*/ dgon pa'i stod zur na yod pa ma gtogs/ gzhan rdzas sne gcig kyang ma bzung bar sbyin pa gtang*/ bde bar ma gshegs kyi bar zhabs tog chud kha nas sbyar te/ nye gnas gcig ma gtogs gzhan su dang yang mi mjal bar mdzad nas thugs dam 'ba' zhig la bzhugs so// khyi lo'i dpyid bdag mjal du phyin pas/ khams bde dge sbyor nan ltar 'phel/ khyed rang yang dge sbyor la dril ba 'thad/ mi nyung ba 'di bas dge sbyor la drag pa mi 'dug gsungs/ sa mo phag gi lo shar ba'i tshe/ da spros pa mang po khams kyis mi nus pa 'dug pas/ chos skyong rnams la gtor ma dus gcig la 'bul ba yin gsungs nas/ gtor ma mang po zhig zhag gsum gyi bar du phul nas/ gtor ma bsngo ba'i rjes ma de la gyis gsungs/ slob dpon dbon po sogs man ngag gi zhu 'phro yod pa rnams da lan shog gsungs nas chos kha cig gsungs nas/ khong tshos don gnyer ba rnams kyi 'phro yang rdzogs yod/ da khrid gsar pa skyong ba sogs chos 'chad pa'i spros pa 'jog pa yin gsungs nas/ sku mtshams dam du btang nas thugs dam gyis dus 'da' bar mdzad do// chu pho byi ba'i lo zla ba dgu pa la zhabs cung zad bsnyung du byung bas/ nye gnas kyis sku mtshams gsengs nas chu tshan la 'byon pa drag zhus pas/

mi phan mi 'gro gsungs/ slob dpon dbon po sogs thams cad kyis zhus pas/ slob dpon chu tshan la tshes brgyad la byon/ der mi mang pos chos 'brel dang*/ byin rlabs srung skud sogs zhus pas grib cig byung nas sku khams drag tu ma song bar tshes bcu la dgon par phebs/ sku khams nyog ge ba zhig byung*/ de'i tshe snang ba thams cad stong gzugs kyi tshe dpag med kyi sku 'ba' zhig tu 'char gyin 'dug pas/ phyi ma la yang tshe ring po cig yong bar 'dug gsungs/ da 'gro bar gda'/ sems kyi 'khri ba cig kyang med/ blo sbyong na 'dug pa'i kha rag pa'i gtam rgyud dang 'dra gsungs/ tshes bco lnga'i nyin phyed yol ba na lus nyams mang po cig mdzad/ gau rī tsau rī zhes sogs kye rdo rje'i 'khor gyi lha mo rnams kyi sngags mang po gsung gin 'dug cung zad cig nas da lta lus nyams mang po 'bab kyin gda' bas sku khams mi lci'am zhus pas/ khams bde/ da lta bdag med ma lha mo bco lnga'i dkyil 'khor la lha thams cad gar byed pa'i snang ba byung shes pa gsal po yod gsungs/ de ltar thugs dam dang dag pa'i snang ba kho nas dus 'da' ba'i ngang nas/ tshes bco lnga'i srod la bab pa na 'da' ka ma'i nyams len khyad par can dang bcas te chos kyi sku'i dbyings su/ gzugs kyi sku'i bkod pa re zhig tu bsdu bar mdzad do// sku gdung zhugs la ba zhen pa'i tshe yang ring bsrel khyad par can 'ga' zhig byung zhing*/ gang zag tha dad kyi gdung skal rnam la yang ring bsrel mang po byon no// dam pa de nyid kyi byin rlabs 'jug cing thugs kyi dgongs pa rdzogs pa'i ched du bdag gis rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang nas rje nyid kyi bar gyi gsung ngag rin po che'i bla ma brgyud pa rnams gtso bor gyur pa la/ bla ma brgyud pa dang yi dam mang pos bskor ba'i bris sku bcu gcig bzhengs te/ de'i ras 'dul la rje nyid kyi gdung dri bzang po dang lhan cig phye mar byas te bgo ba'i ched du gdung btags pa'i gseb nas ring bsrel khyad 'phags gnyis byon no// dam pa gang gi ngang tshul sangs rgyas dang*// tha dad med phyir bdag ltas rtogs par dka'// 'on kyang dad pas mdo tsam bris 'di la// grub chen bla ma'i byin rlabs 'jug gyur cig
